digest.component_or_area: plan-review & code-review documentation and CLI/MCP explain surface
propositions: Authors lack a concise, discoverable on-ramp for writing plans that pass the plan-review gate; existing material is either gate-mechanics or a reviewer-facing criterion registry
Authors lack guidance on passing the code-review (LLM-Review + Verified) gate; AGENTS.md mispoints them at the criterion registry
The CLI/MCP explain seam must be extended to route author-guide names (rebar explain plan, rebar explain review) alongside existing criterion-id lookups via a shared registry
Prose on-ramp docs must remain hand-written and distinct from the generated criterion registry to avoid fighting the parity gate and keep the registry as the single source of truth for reviewers
New top-level docs files must be indexed in docs/README.md to satisfy the docs-index CI gate
